seed: The Library's Media shelf holds the pictures THIS document has, not every screenshot ever taken: a brand new document opens on an empty shelf that says what will fill it and where the captures went, a picture dropped in appears on it, and putting that tile down again is a second layer pointing at the same picture rather than a second copy of it.

steps.note: a brand new document: the Media shelf is empty and says so in plain words, instead of opening full of other documents' screenshots
a picture dropped on the canvas joins the shelf: one tile, captioned with the layer that placed it, saying it is used once
picking the tile opens the picture's own section in the same dock: its name, how much of it is in here already, how big it is, and Place in Picture

Place in Picture puts the same picture down again: a second layer called Hero banner 2, and still ONE tile on the shelf, now reading used 2 times. A second copy of the picture would have split it into two tiles
undo takes the second placement back: the shelf reads used once again, because the shelf is a reading of the document rather than a list of its own
the same tile dragged onto a row of the layers list lands at that place in the stack rather than on top, and it is still the same picture: one tile, used 2 times
